info.name: AQDI API V2 (Full)
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for all routes in `routes/api_v2.php`.

**Base path:** `{{baseUrl}}/api/v2`

**Auth:** Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`) on protected routes. Public folders override with no auth.

**Quick start:**
1. Set `baseUrl` (e.g. `http://localhost:8000`)
2. Run **04 — Public — Auth → Login** — token is saved automatically
3. Use contract/real-estate flows; IDs saved when responses include them

**Notes:**
- Real-estate prefix `/realstate` has alias `/realState`
- File uploads: switch body to `form-data` in Postman
- `add_legal_agent_of_owner` defaults to `false` when omitted (contract step 3 & real-estate step 2)

Generated by `php tools/generate_api_v2_postman_collection.php` — 78 requests.
